internal_sem_root_test_counts_before_tim.scope: lines after the completed internal/gitutil package through, but excluding, the internal/sem FAIL summary
internal_sem_root_test_counts_before_tim.algorithm: Parse only column-zero Go verbose records; take the first whitespace-delimited test name and exclude names containing a slash; deduplicate names independently by RUN, PASS, SKIP, PAUSE, CONT and FAIL record type.

wall_time_note: Individual test durations may overlap and must not be summed as package wall time.
queue_interpretation: Within the internal/sem package interval, 509 root tests had emitted PAUSE and none had emitted CONT when the timeout fired. Exactly one other started root test lacked a terminal record: the named active test, whose subtest had run for 6s. The package was still in its sequential discovery/execution phase and had not released the queued parallel phase. This establishes cumulative package-budget exhaustion before the parallel queue ran, not a demonstrated hang in the last active test.

changed_source_comparison.focused_feature_observation: Changed-feature tests visible in the completed verbose log passed; the longest matching route/ranking/expansion test was TestFullPreindexSearchMatchesColdSelectiveGraphExpansion at 8.20s, and TestGraphRankingEvaluationExpansionUsesIdenticalPreRankPool passed in 1.69s. Production provider.go and search.go are shared by broader tests, so the log does not exclude indirect effects.

runtime_change_result: Increasing GOMAXPROCS from 2 to 4 did not bring internal/sem under its unchanged 30-minute package bound. This is one correctness-gate result, not a performance comparison or causal proof.
next_bounded_fix: Proposed option pending review: change the tracked test runner to execute the complete internal/sem race-test inventory in deterministic, non-overlapping shards with machine-checked coverage and no empty shard, retaining the 30-minute bound per shard and keeping all other packages selected. Existing CI evidence and this option still require review; no sharding change is approved.

slow_fixture_audit.scope: The three slow completed cache-oriented tests were inspected only for their generated repository fixture sizes.
slow_fixture_audit.finding: Their toy repositories contain files ranging from 13 to 169 bytes; this bounded inspection found no repository or retained-evidence growth that explains the package timeout.
